[docs]def myround(x, base=10):
	"""
	Aids in building the age part for the url for Demographic videos
	
	:param x: Patient age 
	:type: int/str
	"""
	tq= 80
	if x == "G":
		tq = "G"
	elif x < 80 :
                tq= int(base * round(float(x)/base))
	else:
		tq=int(80)
	return tq

    

[docs]def VideoUrlBuild( x, y ,z,hs,mbv =0):
	"""
	Aids in building url for Demographic videos
	
	:param x: Patient race 
	:type: str
	:param y: Patient gender 
	:type: str
	:param z: Patient age 
	:type: int
	:param hs: Health state 
	:type: str
	:param mbs: Mechanism for determining what video url to show via mechgambler
	:type: int
	:return: str
	"""
# 1. Order
# 2. VAS
# 3. Standard Gambler
# 4. Time Trade off 
# 5. Video 
# 	0 No Demographic Video
# 	1 Demographic Video
# 	2 Demographci Video GEneral
# 	3 Demogrpahic Video with  Specific
# 	 mechset[mlhold-1] == "1"
# 	 	

#X = Race Y = Gender Z = Age hs = health state mbs = mechgamblevideo
	x = x.capitalize()
	if (mbv == 2 or mbv == 4):
		z = "G"
	if (hs == 1):
		return x + y + str(myround(z)) + "One.mp4"
	if (hs == 2):
		return x + y + str(myround(z)) + "Two.mp4"
	if (hs == 3):
		return x + y + str(myround(z)) + "Three.mp4"
	if (hs == 4):
		return x + y + str(myround(z)) + "Four.mp4"
	if (hs == 5):
		return x + y + str(myround(z)) + "Five.mp4"
	if (hs == 6):
		return x + y + str(myround(z)) + "Six.mp4"
	if (hs == 7):
		return x + y + str(myround(z)) + "Seven.mp4"
	else:
		return x + y + str(myround(z)) + "Eight.mp4"
